rationale_summary: The CP criterion is a single broad requirement about layout of areas and equipment. The supplied Rules provisions all operationalise this same criterion. No explicit connector in the CP or Rules establishes cumulative independent dimensions. The general design requirement (4-2(4)) is specialised by its subparagraphs (4-2(4)(a)(i) and 4-2(4)(c)).
